**Texere 0.4.7** · 11 November 2026

- **Tags in your PDF++ colours.** #fact, #claim, #disagree… now appear in the colour of their highlight in every vault (before, only in the ready-made vault), and they follow PDF++: change a colour there and the tag changes too.
- **New versions show up on the home page sooner.** Texere checks when Obsidian starts, every hour, and when you open the home page (at most every 10 minutes).

Also in this version (from 0.4.6, 0.4.5): highlights are written into the PDF again (PDF++ author set); PDF++ comes ready with Texere's settings; What's new after any update.

Update: the **Update** button on Texere's home page, or BRAT at startup.
